# Tender Response — MRE-2026-02
**Visakoivu Oy** to Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds the required F-gas qualification and a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate.

## 4. Technical requirements

**4.2 Corrective maintenance response times.** Standard corrective faults are attended within one working day of the call being logged.

**4.3 Emergency response.** Emergency situations are covered by an on-call arrangement with response commencing within two hours.

**4.4 Environmental management.** Works are carried out under our environmental management arrangements.

Fire protection and other technical matters are handled in line with our standard maintenance procedures.

## 5. Commercial terms

**5.1 Cost breakdown.** A cost breakdown is provided with the quotation.

**5.2 Payment terms.** 30 days net from invoice date.

## 6. Submission requirements

**6.1 Personnel.** CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract are attached.

**6.2 Pricing.** All prices in this response are quoted in EUR/m²/year, in accordance with the tender's pricing instruction, and no EUR/month figures appear anywhere in this document.

**Submission compliance.** This quotation is submitted as a single PDF file without password protection, and is formatted at a minimum of 11pt throughout, as required. These three requirements have been checked against the tender wording line by line before submission.

## Annex A

Visakoivu Oy operates an environmental management system covering the works described in this tender.

Visakoivu Oy is a 180-person technical and facility services company based in Jyväskylä, operating across LVI, sähkö, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistönhoito. We look forward to supporting Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy's facilities on this contract.
